headline: Continued hearing on Heritage Automotive Group changes at 1580-1620 Shelburne Road, and a sketch plan for a medical building at 860 Community Drive.
summary: Rye Associates, LLC has asked to move its final plat amendment for 1075 Hinesburg Road to December 15, 2026. Minutes from October 20 and November 3 and 17 are also listed, though the November minutes were not yet available.
items: Final plat amendment for Rye Associates, LLC at 1075 Hinesburg Road
Heritage Automotive Group planned unit development amendment at 1580-1620 Shelburne Road
Sketch plan to subdivide two lots and build a medical and social services building at 860 Community Drive
location: South Burlington City Hall Auditorium, 180 Market Street
item_action_words: The applicant has requested this item be continued to December 15, 2026
plain_text:
AGENDA
South Burlington Development Review Board – Regular Meeting
180 Market Street or Online
Tuesday December 1, 2026 | 7:00 p.m.
Board members will attend this meeting in person. Applicants and members of the public may 
attend in person or virtually.
Participation Options:
In person: South Burlington City Hall Auditorium, 180 Market Street 
Assistive Listening Service Devices available upon request – Reach out to Staff or committee 
members before meeting begins.
Virtually (audio and video):  https://zoom.us/j/93936194288
By Telephone (audio only):  (646) 931 3860, Meeting ID: 939 3619 4288
In all cases, you will have the opportunity both to listen AND speak.
Guidance for Virtual Attendees:
l If you are part of the applicant team and are participating in the hearing, use the raise hand 
feature at the beginning of the item and you will be invited to unmute.  You will not be able 
to share your camera. 
l If you wish to participate during Public Comment periods, select the virtual "raise hand" 
option. When recognized by the chair, you will be invited to unmute. 
l The Q&A function is for administrative matters only; comments submitted in the Q&A will 
not be recognized as part of the meeting record. 
l Times are approximate. All hearings are warned to begin at 7:00 PM.
Emergency Evacuation Procedures
Additions, deletions, or changes in order of agenda items.
Announcements.
Comments and questions from the public not related to the agenda.
Final plat application #PZ-FINAL-2026-10 of Rye Associates, LLC, to amend a 
previously approved master plan for residential and commercial subdivision consisting of 52 
housing units on 18.01 acres. The amendment consists of amending the buildings on Lot 6 
from three small multi-unit buildings to one medium multi-unit building, one small muti-unit 
building and one duplex for a total of 11 units, which is one less than the previously 
approved 12 units, and the relocation of a portion of the previously-approved recreation path, 
1075 Hinesburg Road.
The applicant has requested this item be continued to December 15, 2026
Continued final plat application PZ-FINAL-2026-9 of Heritage Automotive Group Inc 
to amend a previously approved Planned Unit Development consisting of a multi building 
complex used for auto sales, service, and repair. The amendment consists of adding to the 
existing 24,087-sf building at 1600 Shelburne Rd and constructing a 17,862-sf addition and 
demolishing the existing 14,808-sf building at 30 Green Mountain Drive and constructing a 
3,721-sf building in its place, stormwater improvements, parking and circulation 
modifications, and associated minor site improvements, 1580 – 1620 Shelburne Road. 
AGENDA 06_PZ-FINAL-2026-9_1580-1620 SHELBURNE ROAD.PDF
Sketch Plan application PZ-SKETCH-2026-16 of 860 Community Drive LLC to 
subdivide two undeveloped existing lots of 5.64 acres (Lot 4) and 7.91 acres (Lot 6) into two 
new lots of 4.44 acres (Lot 4) and 9.11 acres (Lot 6) and develop a single story 48,247 sf 
medical and social services building on Lot 6 with associated site improvements, 860 
Community Dr.
AGENDA 07_PZ-SKETCH-2026-16_860 COMMUNITY DRIVE_VA CLINIC.PDF
Minutes of October 20, November 3, November 17, 2026
The minutes of November 3 and November 17 were not available at the time of packet 
publication.
AGENDA 08_2026-10-20 DRB MINUTES DRAFT.PDF
Other Business
Respectfully Submitted,
Marla Keene, Development Review Planner
Copies of the applications are available for public inspection online and by email by contacting 
mkeene@southburlingtonvt.gov. Participation in the local proceeding is a prerequisite to the right 
to take any subsequent appeal.
South Burlington Development Review Board Meeting Participation Guidelines
The Development Review Board (DRB) presents these guidelines for the public attending 
Development Review Board meetings to ensure that everyone has a chance to speak and that 
meetings proceed smoothly.
The DRB is a Quasi-Judicial Board that oversees the adjudication of development projects within 
the City. It is made up of citizens appointed by the City Council. The role of the DRB is to hear and 
review applications for development under the applicable regulations. The DRB can only approve 
applications that comply with the applicable bylaw or state law, and the board can only levy 
conditions that are permitted under the bylaw. By the same token, if a project meets the 
applicable bylaw criteria, the DRB is bound by law to grant the approval.
1. The Board asks that all participants at meetings be respectful of Board members, staff, 
applicants and other members of the public present at the meeting. 
2. Initial discussion on an agenda item will generally be conducted by the Board and the 
applicant. As this is our opportunity to engage with the subject, we would like to hear from 
all Board members first. After the Board members have discussed an item, the Chair will 
open up the floor for public comment. Please raise your hand to be recognized to speak 
and the Chair will try to call on each participant in sequence. 
3. Once recognized by the Chair, please identify yourself to the Board. 
4. If the Board suggests time limits, please respect them. Time limits will be used when they 
can aid in making sure everyone is heard and sufficient time is available for Board to hear all 
items on the agenda. 
5. Side conversations between audience members should be kept to an absolute minimum. 
The hallway outside the meeting room is available should people wish to chat more fully. 
6. Please address the Chair. Please do not address other audience members or staff or 
presenters and please do not interrupt others when they are speaking. The Chair will direct 
responses from applicable people as needed. 
7. Make every effort not to repeat the points made by others and keep your comments 
germane to the issue before the Board. 
8. The Chair will make reasonable efforts to allow everyone who is interested in participating to 
speak once before speakers address the Board for a second time. 
9. Comments may be submitted before or during the course of a single or multi-meeting public 
hearing to the Planning and Zoning Department. All comments should identify what 
application the correspondence is in reference to. All written comments will be circulated to 
the DRB and kept as part of the official records of meetings. Comments must include your 
first and last name and a contact (e -mail, phone, address) to be included in the record. 
10. Please note that once a public hearing has been closed by the DRB, no further comments 
can be accepted, in accordance with state law.
